description: After executing a task, store the result so future identical or similar tasks return a cache hit via dedupq_check. Costs 2 credits.

content.description: Original task content. Used to compute hash and embedding for future matching.

hash_only.description: If true, skip embedding generation. Default: false.

result.description: The task result to cache. Can be any JSON value.

task_id.description: Optional task ID. Used as the database row ID if provided.

name: dedupq_complete
